We need a builder with strong business acumen who understands a business requirement, identifies what can be automated, develops the solution, integrates it with our existing systems, tests it and takes it into production. Build APIs, databases, dashboards and integrations required for end-to-end automation. Evaluate new AI tools/models and rapidly convert useful technologies into working business applications. Deploy, monitor and continuously improve AI applications in production. What We Are Really Looking For We want someone who thinks: Why is a person doing this manually? Can I automate it using AI? The ideal candidate should have a strong combination of coding ability + AI knowledge + automation mindset + business understanding . You should be able to understand a business process, identify inefficiencies and independently propose and develop a better AI-powered solution. Experience with tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier or equivalent workflow automation platforms will also be preferred. Preferred Project Experience We particularly want candidates who have already built at least some of the following: AI Agents | HRMS/ERP | Resume Parser | Recruitment Automation | Job Portal | AI Chatbot | Voice Agent | Social Media Automation | RAG Application | AI Video/Content Automation | Lead Generation Automation | Business Process Automation Candidates should be able to demonstrate their actual projects during the interview. Business Acumen Is Essential We are specifically looking for a developer who understands that technology must ultimately produce measurable business results. You should be able to understand questions such as: Can this process be automated? Can AI reduce manpower or turnaround time? Can we improve productivity through AI? Can this system generate more leads or revenue? Can we improve customer/candidate experience? Can multiple manual processes be converted into one automated workflow? Can we build this as a scalable SaaS/product? Candidate Profile Education: B.Tech/B.E./MCA/BCA/B.Sc. Computer Science or equivalent. Exceptional developers with strong practical portfolios may also be considered. We value demonstrated ability and completed projects more than certificates alone. Our objective is to use AI to automate business processes and develop scalable products across HRTech, Recruitment, Skill Development, Social Media, Business Automation and SaaS platforms .
